methodology.purpose: Compare raw, normalised-slope, and normalised-slope-plus-acceleration entry signals without allowing portfolio positions or forward diagnostics to cross chronological split boundaries.
methodology.normalisation: Regression slope divided by the candle close price, producing fractional price movement per minute.
methodology.splitLeakageProtection: Signals may use historical candles before the period start for indicator lookback, but simulations and forward diagnostics are hard-clipped at the period end. Positions open at the boundary are marked to the final in-period close and cannot consume later candles.
